CLAIM_GRADIENT_CORRECTION.statement: Actual adapter training loop implements analytical two-branch functional loss gradient matching finite differences with relative error < 0.05.

CLAIM_CAUSAL_ACTIVITY_NOT_CAPABILITY_TRA.statement: Transplanted circuit produces positive causal drop upon ablation, but does not achieve donor functional identity (exact agreement < 90%).

CLAIM_OVERSIZED_CONTROL_SATURATION.statement: Oversized 8-node circuit provides zero additional causal gain over minimal functional circuit.

CLAIM_HELDOUT_ACTIVATION_PATCH.statement: Donor activation patching improves recipient accuracy by +10.0 pp on both validation and held-out test splits.
